gui.aurelia.jump.title: Jump to a station, platform, depot or siding
gui.aurelia.jump.none: Nothing to jump to. Open this from the MTR dashboard.
gui.aurelia.jump.no_permission: Jumping uses /tp: you need operator rights or cheats on.
gui.aurelia.tools.melodies.tooltip: Tells Joban Client Mod vehicle scripts whether to play departure melodies. Scripts that do not read this setting ignore it.
gui.aurelia.tools.announcer.tooltip: Announces the next station, arrivals, changes and the last stop on MTR trains you ride. The lines go to chat and replace MTR's own chat announcement while you ride. Plays station clips (sound events mtr:aureliaex_ann_<key>) from a resource pack that provides them; without them it is text only.
gui.aurelia.tools.announcer.action_bar.t: Also shows the next stop, and the interchange or terminus, on the action bar when an announcement plays.
gui.aurelia.tools.announcer.wording.tool: Standard is the Announcer's own English. British follows the platform speakers' British style. Voice-pack clips stay the same either way.
gui.aurelia.presets.apply_depot.tooltip: Apply the preset to every siding of this siding's depot. Sidings it does not fit are skipped and named.
gui.aurelia.presets.settings.tooltip: Also save the siding's other settings with the train: acceleration, deceleration, max trains or manual driving, manual speed and the delay options. Applying such a preset sets them too.
gui.aurelia.presets.applied_depot: Applied "%s" to %s siding(s) in %s. Regenerate the depot if trains do not update.
gui.aurelia.presets.skipped: %s siding(s) skipped (too short or wrong type).
gui.aurelia.tools.platform.tooltip: When you stand on a platform, announces its next train in chat: about a minute before, while it arrives, and when it runs late. Uses the arrival times MTR's own departure screens show. Plays mtr:aureliaex_ann_platform_approaching / _arriving / _delayed from a resource pack that has them, otherwise a chime.
gui.aurelia.return.title: Return route
gui.aurelia.return.name: Name of the new route
gui.aurelia.return.pick_route: Pick the route to build the return of.
gui.aurelia.return.deleted_platform: This route stops at a platform that no longer exists. Fix it in MTR first.
gui.aurelia.return.created: Created "%s" with %s stops. Add it to a depot to run trains on it.
gui.aurelia.return.created_depots: Created "%s" with %s stops and added it to %s depot(s). Regenerate them so trains run it.
gui.aurelia.return.help: Stops run in reverse. Green stops moved to the other platform of their station; the ends keep theirs. Pick a stop and press Other platform to change it. Same colour, number and type as the original.
gui.aurelia.speed.title: Speed check
gui.aurelia.speed.summary: %s rail(s) within render distance: %s slow spot(s), %s fast curve(s). Only rails near you are checked: MTR sends no others to your game.
gui.aurelia.speed.slow_detail: Slow spot: this rail allows %s km/h while the rails on both ends allow at least %s km/h. Trains brake for it every time. Usually one segment laid with the wrong rail type: replace it with MTR's rail tools.
gui.aurelia.speed.curve_detail: Fast curve: radius %s m at %s km/h. About %s km/h is comfortable for that radius on a real line. MTR does not slow trains for curves, so this is only advice.
gui.aurelia.speed.clean: No slow spots and no fast curves among the rails around you.
gui.aurelia.speed.no_rails: No rails near you. Stand near the line you want to check.
gui.aurelia.speed.help: Pick a finding for details. Jump takes you to it.
gui.aurelia.trains.title: Train inspector
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.no_departures: Has no departures: the timed list is empty, or every hour is set to no trains. No train will ever leave.
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.siding_isolat: Siding %s has no track leading out of it, so its trains cannot reach the route. (Checked for sidings within render distance only.)
gui.aurelia.depots.problem.platform_no_s: Stops at %s, which is in no station zone: departure screens and announcements show nothing there.
gui.aurelia.panel.title: Aurelia panel
gui.aurelia.pantograph.animation.tooltip: Off keeps every pantograph lowered, as modelled
gui.aurelia.pantograph.end.tooltip: Which end rises for parts that do not choose one, relative to the direction of travel
gui.aurelia.architecture.studio.tooltip: Opens Station Studio in your browser
gui.aurelia.architecture.station.tooltip: Plan or build the station on the wrench in your hand
gui.aurelia.architecture.station.hold: Hold a Station Wrench to use this
gui.aurelia.architecture.airport.tooltip: Plan or build the airport on the wrench in your hand
gui.aurelia.architecture.airport.hold: Hold an Airport Wrench to use this
gui.aurelia.builder.hold: Hold a Rail Builder to change it
gui.aurelia.riding.sit.tooltip: Each ride starts sitting or standing. The sit key (X by default) switches while you ride.
gui.aurelia.train_sound.wide_pitch.toolt: Vanilla limits every sound to pitch 0.5-2. On: train sounds go from 0.25 up to the maximum below, so BVE motor tables play as written.
Old-style (non-BVE) trains jump between motor clips at each speed step. This bends the pitch across a step so the jump is smaller.
gui.aurelia.train_sound.door_chime.toolt: Plays once on every train as its doors start to close.
